FN-J3MSFNY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 379
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Faulkner
Commissions
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/09/2024
House Bill 379 as introduced would expand the membership of certain county boards of
equalization from three members to five members, which would increase the obligations of the
following funds/entities by the following estimated annual amounts:
Jefferson County General Jefferson County Mapping
Source State General Fund
Fund and Reappraisal Fund
Amount $44,250 $18,600 $18,000
